description: This file defines an authentication context provider for a React application, managing user authentication state, including login, register, and logout functionalities, using context and hooks.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Provides authentication state and actions to child components, manages user state and loading state, initializes user from token, and exposes login, register, logout functions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom React hook to access authentication context, throws error if used outside of AuthProvider.
